title: Convergent Form, Divergent Voice II — Corpus
description: Research corpus of freeflow and values probes with explicit deployment provenance. The 1.2.58 release candidate adds 245 revision-pinned original Yi 34B Chat BF16 Colab/vLLM traces. No new DOI is claimed. Summary: 70,117 valid samples, 612 probe cells, 206 model labels; deployment labels are not unique-weight identities.
